title: Your Business Info
description: Tell Jawab about your business — your story, policies, style, and answers to common questions — so it replies accurately.
descriptionStructuredHint: Exact prices and schedules belong in your lists, so replies stay correct when they change.

freeTextInfo.title: What goes here?
freeTextInfo.what: Free text is best for what's unique to you: your brand story, policies, tone, and Q&A examples in your own words.
freeTextInfo.structured: Exact prices, sizes, and schedules belong in your lists — items there are updated in one tap and expire on time.
freeTextInfo.why: This split keeps Jawab's answers accurate even as your details change.

thinKbTip: The more details you add, the better Jawab answers your customers. Think about what your customers ask most often.
